message.content:
The most visited market in New York City is **Union Square Greenmarket**.  
It’s the largest of the city’s greenmarkets, drawing hundreds of thousands of visitors each season. The market’s central location, wide variety of local produce, artisanal foods, and frequent events make it a top destination for both residents and tourists.
